text:
alex_k: quick sync — ACME wants a bundled proposal: Hosted API + Optimize (model-tuning + evals) + Console retention add-on (90d). 12 month term, asking for a single committed $/mo with some flexibility on ramp. also flagged: SAML + SOC2 evidence.

maria_sales: do we have a baseline list price to start from? they asked for an apples-to-apples comparison vs their current vendor.

sam_pricing: ballpark we can offer: 1) $420k annual commit (12m) => 18% cross-product bundle discount, 2) $600k => 25% + free 30d Optimize pilot. add-on (Console retention) usually at 10% of API spend but we can fold into bundle. need dealdesk signoff for >20% off.

jamie_eng: POC note: if they want dedicated capacity for low-latency parts of the POC we'll need a Dedicated pool request; default hosted is fine for evaluation. for SAML we can do an enterprise connector — timeline ~1 week if they provide metadata.

tara_security: security checklist: send SQ (I’ll take the questionnaire), need SOC2 report and data flow diagram. if they require HIPAA, we need legal sign-off — confirm ask.

chris_dealdesk: @alex_k @sam_pricing thanks — for >20% discounts we need a short rationale + customer ARR/strategic note. also require: (a) signed commitment letter, (b) term sheet with any special termination language, and (c) internal approval ticket. I can shepherd but need the final numbers.

dealbot: Rate card link: https://redwood.example.com/ratelists/2026-q1 (internal). Automated estimate: {"sku":"API-units","price_unit":"per-1k-tokens","std_price":"$0.002","bundle_adj":"see pricing model"} :robot_face:

alex_k: copying the proposed tier: 
- Option A: $420k/yr (18% bundle) -> API + Optimize + Console retention 90d
- Option B: $600k/yr (25% bundle + 30d Optimize pilot)
We should show monthly equivalent and headroom for a 6-month ramp.

maria_sales: i'll prepare a customer-facing one-pager w/ monthly equivalents and call out the Optimize pilot. can someone confirm whether we can commit to a 30-day free pilot for Optimize?

sam_pricing: yes to a 30d pilot only with the $600k commit. otherwise pilot available as paid POC at list rates. also suggest a conditional 3% extra discount if they sign a 24-month contract.

jamie_eng: POC runbook (short):
1) provision hosted trial keys
2) run small eval workload (10k tokens/day)
3) if low-latency required, spin dedicated staging: `./deploy poc --env acme --pool dedicated --gpus 2`
4) provide SAML metadata to jamie_eng@redwood for connector setup

tara_security: i'll start the SQ. please upload SOC2 and any encryption/KMS docs to the secure share. timeline: aim to complete in 7 business days.

chris_dealdesk: copying the approval checklist: rationale + final rate matrix + signed commit + legal AAD. Once we have that i can route for approval today. if we exceed 25% discount we need VP sign-off.

alex_k: next steps: maria prepares one-pager, sam finalizes matrix and discount justification, jamie preps POC staging and SAML checklist, tara sends SQ. chris will queue dealdesk ticket once we have the doc bundle. Can we target an internal review at 11am PT tomorrow?

maria_sales: yes — i'll post draft by 9am PT.

sam_pricing: i'll attach the cost model and sensitivity table to the channel before 10am.

jamie_eng: noted, i'll stand by for metadata and can start the connector work ASAP.

tara_security: ack, starting SQ now.

alex_k: thanks all — tagging @chris_dealdesk for visibility :thumbsup:
